basics.name: Nguyen Vu Huy
basics.label: AI/Data Scientist
basics.summary: Data scientist and AI engineer working on natural language processing, retrieval-augmented generation, and agentic AI systems. My work spans the full path from data to a deployed model: exploration and feature engineering, training and evaluation, and serving the result behind an API. I hold a Bachelor of Science in Artificial Intelligence from FPT University and have published peer-reviewed work on low-resource machine translation and object detection.

work.name: VinUni × Vingroup — AI in Action (AI20k)
work.summary: Selected for the advanced track of Vingroup's 20,000 Applied AI Talent Program — an intensive, SFIA-aligned program pairing coursework with hands-on AI projects delivered at Vingroup companies.
highlights: Building production-grade agentic AI systems: multi-agent orchestration with LangGraph, tool integration via the Model Context Protocol (MCP) and agent-to-agent (A2A) communication, retrieval-augmented generation, and LLM evaluation and guardrails.
Applying LLMOps and observability practices — containerized deployment with Docker and monitoring/tracing stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry) — to ship reliable, cost-aware AI services.

work.name: TPBank
highlights: Queried and explored data from the UAT database using SQL to understand banking data structures and perform EDA.
Learned the CRISP-DM methodology and its application to real-world data science workflows in banking.
Participated in technical mentoring sessions covering TPBank's data model and machine learning models.
Gained exposure to data profiling, data quality assessment, and data preprocessing workflows through mentor-led walkthroughs of previous project codebases.

work.name: FPT Software
highlights: Built a Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) chatbot using Python, Qdrant Vector Database, and FastAPI for knowledge retrieval.
Contributed to the development of a Java-based movie ticket booking web application in an Agile Scrum environment.
Assisted the backend team by supporting Java development tasks and collaborating on feature implementation.

work.name: AI VIET NAM — AIO2024 Cohort
highlights: Completed a one-year intensive residency of 300+ sessions covering mathematics for AI, machine learning, deep learning, computer vision, NLP, and generative AI / LLMs.
Contributed to the AI VIET NAM Research Group; co-authored peer-reviewed papers in machine translation and object detection.

projects.name: RAG Chatbot for E-commerce Product Q&A
projects.description: A retrieval-augmented generation chatbot answering product queries for an online store: gte-multilingual-base embeddings, a Qdrant vector database with cosine-similarity semantic search, and Gemini 2.0 Flash for answer generation — fast, multilingual, context-aware responses.

projects.name: Fine-tuned BERT for Vietnamese Sentiment Classification
projects.description: Fine-tuned a BERT model on the NTC-SCV dataset for sentiment analysis, with the code and training pipeline published on GitHub.

projects.name: Vietnam News Crawling & Text Classification
projects.description: An end-to-end Vietnamese-news NLP pipeline (web scraping → EDA → model training → deployment): scraped and cleaned thousands of news articles into a structured CSV dataset, engineered TF-IDF features and trained a multi-class XGBoost classifier (evaluated with confusion matrix and accuracy / F1), and deployed the model as a Flask web app for real-time classification.
